config.name: Dr.Bokeh full 200-scene input-protocol recovery; fixed geometry/gamma/lens

branches.full_public: Reuse saved LDF + LaMa two-layer outputs and metrics; no oracle inputs
branches.gt_alpha: Replace LDF only with existing PNG8 union alpha of all four synthetic foregrounds; retain official RGBAD2layers, cv2 foreground depth repair and LaMa RGB/depth repair
branches.oracle_layers: Four known RGBA foreground assets plus known background, front to back; bypass LDF and all inpainting; original Dr.Bokeh multi-layer renderer

fixed.geometry: Per-frame visible disparity min/max; focus transformed by the same values; K_Dr=K*span; no clamp

config.oracle_disparity: Quantize each known plane 1/z to PNG8/255 before applying the SAME visible-input min/max. Verify reconstructed visible disparity PNG exactly. Do not add continuous-depth precision as another factor.
config.asset_checks: Known layers must reproduce the existing sRGB RGB PNG, foreground-union alpha PNG and thresholded visible disparity PNG exactly before rendering
limits: Synthetic composition assets are not independent physical foreground color truth.
The five-layer branch jointly changes layer count, hidden RGB, alpha and geometry; it is not a pure LaMa ablation.
Oracle improvement does not establish what Any-to-Bokeh's unpublished adapter used.
FVD covariance is across video feature vectors; it does not uniquely measure temporal flicker.
No gamma, geometry or blur-strength search in this stage; no automatic change to Table 1A or frozen 200-scene baseline.
All branches use the same fixed 200 scenes; this is reproduction development, not independent held-out validation.
The 11 diagnostic scenes are reused without changing protocol; original 8 and posthoc 3 groups remain separately reported.
Run GT-alpha branch first, then known layers, then common evaluation; no gamma, geometry or blur-strength search.

base_protocol.name: Dr.Bokeh full-pipeline implementation preflight, then single-adapter Track A
base_protocol.predicted_alpha: Official LDF model-40, from RGB only; official resize/normalization and sigmoid
base_protocol.layer_pipeline: Official RGBAD2layers; two layers; foreground cv2 depth inpaint, background LaMa RGB AND depth inpaint; Multi_Layer_Renderer
base_protocol.normalization: lo=min(d); span=max(d)-lo; d_prime=(d-lo)/span; focus_prime=(focus-lo)/span; no focus clamp
base_protocol.K_mapping: K_Dr = K_manifest * span; preserves K_Dr*(d_prime-focus_prime)=K_manifest*(d-focus) BEFORE layer preprocessing
base_protocol.constant_disparity_policy: Stop and report; no silent fallback or per-scene parameter change
base_protocol.precision: FP32 render/model, TF32 disabled; preserve official NumPy/OpenCV preprocessing dtypes
base_protocol.output: Independent frames; clamp only final RGB to [0,1], record out-of-range fraction before clamp, round to RGB PNG8

kernel_check.scope: Engineering tolerance declared before probe; not a paper score threshold or proof for arbitrary occlusion normalization

preflight_checks: Same 8 scenes, 25 frames each, 1024x576; filename focus matches metadata
Before layers, signed CoC algebra matches existing input control after K compensation
Record LDF coverage and empty/full masks; poor segmentation is a retained method failure unless the pipeline becomes undefined.
Foreground/background RGBAD finite; inspect LaMa RGB and depth fills separately
Record actual layer disparity range and maximum nominal radius after preprocessing
Check radial tail coverage for actual post-preprocessing radius; if failed, stop without clipping
Check final output shape/range and focus-region visual behavior
Inspect 0/6/12/18/24 frame diagnostics; compare 71 versus 101 on identical saved layers from the fixed K32 scenes, because near-zero normalization weights can amplify small kernel tails
limits: No public evidence located that Any-to-Bokeh gives Dr.Bokeh GT alpha or oracle layers; absence of disclosure is not proof of their actual private settings.

Dr.Bokeh CVPR 2024 section 5.2 replaces predicted occluded pixels by GT pixels for MPIB/Dr.Bokeh and searches blur kernels. This is a different experiment and does not establish Any-to-Bokeh's unpublished adapter.
Official demo does not transform its focal argument for the caller; adapter must transform it consistently.
CUDA scatter_dis=abs(relative_disparity)*K_Dr+1 with a softstep edge, not an ideal hard disk of exactly the nominal radius.
lens is a kernel side length; circular mask uses distance < floor(lens/2); soft tails never have exactly finite support.
K compensation preserves nominal input CoC, not full-pipeline equivalence: depth inpainting and fixed disparity-domain occlusion thresholds are not affine invariant.
A single oracle-alpha image would still not reveal all hidden RGBA layers and is not a pure-renderer ground truth test.
The native soft kernel has nonzero residual spread at nominal radius zero; do not demand exact identity as an implementation pass condition.
User authorized the full 200 scenes only after the fixed 8-scene implementation checks pass; no paper-score selection or additional candidates.

layered_lens_check.edge_definition: 5x5 morphological gradient of LDF alpha>0.1, OR input normalized disparity local range>1/255
layered_lens_check.selection: If 71/101 differences exceed tolerance on the same saved layers, use 101 as coverage correction; no paper metrics consulted.
